check: KGP protocol and governance projection/reorg replay, PostgreSQL restart reconnect, and durable lease recovery after worker crash
database_network: default bridge; outbound calls are not used
schema_migration_mode: ordered validated repository schema sources; one transaction per file
limitations: All 394 current ordered PostgreSQL schema migrations were applied, but the deployment, cursor, contract addresses, prelinked guild, and governance rows are synthetic; no seed data or candidate/legacy database was used.

Live Web3/RPC was not used. Seven synthetic GuildCreated, DomainCreated, TaskCreated, TargetPermissionUpdated, TargetSelectorPermissionUpdated, and GuildScopedTargetUpdated logs were supplied to the real indexer; chain height and replacement tip hash were stubbed.

Canonical duplicate replay and a simulated seven-event reorg/reappearance were exercised using synthetic logs; a repeated target permission update verified that current state follows the latest event and replay rebuilds from canonical history. No real chain reorganization was observed.
The PostgreSQL container had no volume and published only a loopback port. The default bridge permits egress, but this check makes no external provider or chain calls.
